root.statement: Select and verify the smallest end-to-end product slices that materially move Soltex from engineering console to dependable daily-use Windows utility.
root.source_state: Exact-head installed Soltex is functional and visually coherent but cold-eye review found weak cross-module flow, clipped Security activity, passive sparse states, no recoverable Audio mix recall, and no bounded measurement workflow.
root.target_state: The native app exposes fast navigation, a recoverable read-back-backed Audio workflow, and one honest bounded local benchmark while preserving security, privacy, lifecycle, and performance boundaries.

No production deployment or destructive source operation is part of the current slice.

Source changes are isolated and reviewable; Audio and benchmark state are explicitly clearable and recover from malformed input, while scratch is always cleaned.

hypotheses.statement: A searchable keyboard command surface and explicit shortcuts will reduce cross-module friction without increasing visible information density.
hypotheses.mechanism: Ctrl+K offers one focused overlay over the existing navigation model and routes through the same ShowPanel state transition.
hypotheses.distinguishing_prediction: Keyboard and click tests can reach every visible workspace and focus returns safely after dismissal.
hypotheses.falsifier: The overlay traps focus, duplicates state, or makes 1280 x 820 containment worse.
hypotheses.decision_if_true: Ship the command surface and keep the sidebar quiet.

confidence.basis: Bounded catalog tests, shared routing, and native command-surface capture passed.

hypotheses.statement: A single bounded Audio mix snapshot provides meaningful recovery and product depth without pretending to be an EQ or virtual audio router.
hypotheses.mechanism: Persist displayed app and endpoint labels plus volume/mute, re-observe live sessions, apply only exact controllable matches, and require Core Audio read-back for each write.
hypotheses.distinguishing_prediction: Store tests recover from invalid data and planner/controller tests report verified, missing, and failed entries explicitly.
hypotheses.falsifier: The snapshot can target ambiguous sessions, persists raw identifiers, or hides partial failure.
hypotheses.decision_if_true: Expose capture, apply, and confirmed clear controls in Audio.

confidence.basis: Persistence, matching, recovery, privacy, action-state, and native UI tests passed.

hypotheses.statement: A short named-measurement benchmark can add useful Performance depth without unsafe stress or an unvalidated marketing score.
hypotheses.mechanism: Run fixed sequential CPU, memory, and handle-owned scratch-storage workloads while live sampling is paused; persist one stream-bounded result and expose limitations beside it.
hypotheses.distinguishing_prediction: The production profile completes within its wall-clock bound, reports every stage, cleans owned scratch, cancels when the lab is left, and exposes no composite score or rank.
hypotheses.falsifier: A run exceeds its bound, leaves scratch, continues outside the visible lab, hides cancellation/failure, or presents incomparable results as a universal score.
hypotheses.decision_if_true: Ship Quick local benchmark as a Performance-owned mode and keep extended thermal/GPU profiles out.

confidence.basis: Production profile, benign boundary and recovery inputs, exact-length checks, cancellation/navigation, persistence, telemetry policy, and native UI tests passed.

closure.summary: The highest-priority shell, Security layout, Audio recovery, and bounded benchmark slices are implemented; exact-commit source, native, runtime, and self-contained package gates pass locally, while installer execution, hosted acceptance, and owner acceptance remain open.
residual_risks: Production signing and update release configuration remain owner-controlled.
The 1.0.2 installer compiled but its launch was denied before execution; upgrade, rollback, and state preservation are not established for this commit.
GG-level audio DSP or virtual routing is out of scope without a separately supported architecture.
GPU, thermal, stability, and cross-machine benchmark claims are not supported.

Real-world exploitability of the two filesystem race hypotheses was not dynamically established because policy-safe validation was intentionally not attempted; this slice is defensive hardening, not a vulnerability verdict.
Human visual acceptance is not yet recorded.
